Breakfast at the hotel. Reception in the lobby to begin our city tour of Muscat. After the visit, we will continue our journey to Al Alam Palace (photo stop), flanked by the two Portuguese forts, Jalali and Mirani. We will visit the Bait Al Zubair Museum to understand a little more about Omani culture and history. We will then continue our tour along the Corniche promenade to Mutrah Souq, one of the oldest souks in Oman.
